## Title
XSpaceWar-AI

## Tagline (≤ 80 chars)
AI-driven networked Spacewar! — real Newtonian gravity, 100% procedural.

## Short description (~200 chars)
A 2026 reimagining of the classic networked Spacewar!. Top-down dogfights around a
gravity well with true Newtonian physics, fully procedural graphics & audio, brutal AI
(Rookie → Insane), and LAN + internet multiplayer for up to 16 ships. Free & open source.

## Long description
XSpaceWar-AI is a modern, AAA-styled networked space-fighter with a strong AI focus — a
2026 reimagining of the classic networked *Spacewar!* / `xspacewar`. Bird's-eye view like
the 1962 original, but with space-accurate **Newtonian physics**, **100% procedurally
generated graphics and audio** (no hand-drawn art; every sound synthesized from math at
load), and **LAN + internet multiplayer for up to 16 ships**.

### Features
- Top-down arena dogfights around a gravity well, up to **16 ships**.
- Real **Newtonian flight** — conserved momentum, inverse-square gravity on ships *and*
  torpedoes, gravity-assist slingshots, hyperspace.
- **Procedurally generated everything** — stars, planets, moons, asteroid fields, nebulae,
  ships, VFX, and audio; every match a fresh seeded arena.
- **Game modes:** Free-for-all, Team battle, AI bots (Rookie → Insane), and Movie Mode
  (an all-AI attract that regenerates a fresh arena every 30 minutes).
- **Multiplayer today:** host-authoritative netcode with client-side prediction +
  reconciliation, automatic LAN discovery, direct IP, and platform-agnostic internet play
  via the project's own relay/master server — room codes, an online server browser, no
  port forwarding or platform services required.
- **Seven UI languages:** English, Spanish, French, Simplified Chinese, Arabic (RTL), Hindi.

### Heritage
Stands on *Spacewar!* (MIT, 1962, PDP-1), the 1974 PDP-11 networked port, and Ron
Frederick's 1992 X11 `xspacewar 1.2`. An original clean-room implementation — see NOTICE.

## System requirements
- **OS:** Windows 10+ (x86_64), macOS 11+ (universal), or Linux (x86_64, glibc).
- **Graphics:** GPU with Vulkan or current OpenGL; HDR glow needs a real GPU.
- **Disk:** ~100 MB. **Network:** required only for online multiplayer.

## Opening on macOS
The macOS build is ad-hoc signed but not notarized, so on first launch Gatekeeper may say
*"XSpaceWar-AI is damaged and can't be opened."* It isn't — that's just macOS blocking an
un-notarized download. Open it via **right-click → Open → Open**, or run
`xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /path/to/XSpaceWar-AI.app` in Terminal, or use
System Settings → Privacy & Security → **Open Anyway**.
